section.sectionSummaryBrief: To win this war, service based on reason or even above reason but still connected to it is insufficient, because the Greeks defiled even the oils in the Hekel; victory requires the service of mesirus nefesh stemming from the essence of the soul, the level of Yechidah, which is impervious to impurity.
section.t: Now, in order to win this war,
service that is according to reason and intellect is insufficient,
and even service that is above reason and intellect but is connected to reason and intellect
(the service that is from the aspect of the encompassing light of the level of 46,
the close encompassing light),
is insufficient, because they defiled all the oils that were in the Hekel,
meaning also the matters of holiness that are above reason and intellect but are connected to reason and intellect.
And the victory of the war is specifically through the service of mesirus nefesh,
for the concept of mesirus nefesh is standing with force against all obstacles and hindrances,
an essential force that is completely above intellect,
like mesirus nefesh for the sanctification of G-d's Name, which is not due to any intellectual reasoning,
but rather,
it is simply impossible to be otherwise47.
And this comes from the connection of the essence of the soul,
the level of Yechidah,
for the concept of an essential connection is that it is simply impossible to be otherwise, G-d forbid48.
And since in the level of Yechidah there is no place for any defect or impurity, G-d forbid
(similar to the single cruse of oil that was sealed with the seal of the Kohen Gadol,
which the external forces could not touch49),
therefore, through the service of mesirus nefesh that comes from the Yechidah,
specifically through this do we win the war.
And as it was in the war against the Greeks in its simple sense,
that through the mesirus nefesh of Matisyahu and his sons,
for even though they were weak and few, nevertheless they stood with mesirus nefesh to fight against the mighty and numerous,
and through this they aroused and effected also in the people of their generation to give their lives for the sanctification of G-d's Name, not to transgress the religion in any way,
and through this they won the war50.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: The victory achieved through mesirus nefesh is complete, because it stems from the essence and permeates all soul powers, and regarding the level of Yechidah there is no opposing force; moreover, its revelation transforms even the animal soul.
section.t: Now, the victory of the war that is achieved through the service of mesirus nefesh is a complete victory.
For in addition to the fact that the service of mesirus nefesh,
since it comes from the essence,
penetrates all the powers of the soul down to the power of action,
so that in all his affairs it is evident that "this is a Jew acting with mesirus nefesh,"
and similar to what is said about Avraham51
"Because Avraham listened to My voice,"
that through his mesirus nefesh he effected that even his heel listened
(heard)
the command of the Holy One, blessed be He52,
there is additionally this,
that regarding the level of Yechidah there is no opposing force.
For in service according to reason and intellect,
and even in service above reason and intellect that is connected to reason and intellect,
it is possible that there be an opposing force.
But not so when one arouses and reveals his level of Yechidah,
it is impossible for there to be an opposing force53.
And moreover,
not only that, but in the revelation of the level of Yechidah in the soul,
it also affects the animal soul,
so that the very materiality of the animal soul is transformed from one extreme to the other54.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This explains why Chanukah lights differ from the Temple lights in number and time of lighting, as Chanukah represents the service of mesirus nefesh from the level of Yechidah, above the order of Hishtalshelus, corresponding to the number eight, like the eight-stringed harp of the Messianic era.
section.t: With this will be understood why the Chanukah lights differ from the lights of the Temple both in their number and in the time of their lighting,
for the concept of Chanukah is the service of mesirus nefesh from the aspect of the level of Yechidah,
above the order of Hishtalshelus
(in man),
and therefore they are eight lights,
for the number eight is connected
(as mentioned above in section 1)
with the level that is above the order of Hishtalshelus.
And similar to the difference between the harp of the Temple, which had seven strings,
and the harp of the days of Moshiach, which will have eight strings55.
For even though the Temple is the holiest place in the world,
and especially the harp of the Temple, which is the concept of drawing down the Name Havayah,
for "kinor" (harp) has the letters of "kaf-vav" (26)
(the numerical value of the Name Havayah)
"ner" (candle)56
Havayah is the soul of man)58,
nevertheless, it is only the perfection of the order of Hishtalshelus,
and therefore it had seven strings.
But not so in the days of Moshiach, when there will be a revelation that is above the order of Hishtalshelus
(the supernal Name Havayah),
it will have eight strings59.
